name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as shown in the logs

username.title: Tapo Account Email
username.description: The email address of the Tapo account the devices are set up with. Turn on Third-Party Compatibility in the Tapo app for local control.

password.title: Tapo Account Password
password.description: The password of the Tapo account.

waitTimeUpdate.title: Write Grouping (in milliseconds)
waitTimeUpdate.description: How long a change from HomeKit waits for the ones made with it, so a colour or a slider sends one request.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The Tapo plugs and bulbs, each by its address on the local network.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name in HomeKit. With the address, it is what the accessory is known by: changing either makes a new accessory.

host.title: IP Address
host.description: The device's IP address or host name on the local network.

updateInterval.title: Update Interval (in seconds)
updateInterval.description: How often the device is asked for its state.

timeout.title: Timeout (in seconds)
timeout.description: How long a request to a device on older firmware waits for its answer.

fr.The Tapo plugs and bulbs, each by its ad: Les prises et ampoules Tapo, chacune par son adresse sur le réseau local.
fr.How long a change from HomeKit waits for: Le temps qu'un changement venu de HomeKit attend ceux faits en même temps, pour qu'une couleur ou un curseur n'envoie qu'une requête.
fr.How long a request to a device on older: Le temps qu'une requête à un appareil au firmware ancien attend sa réponse.
fr.How often the device is asked for its st: La fréquence à laquelle l'état de l'appareil est demandé.
